The 1972 book *Sino‑Tibetan: A Conspectus* by Paul K. Benedict devotes an entire chapter to each of the following Proto‑Sino‑Tibetan prefixes:

| Prefix | Chapter title (as listed in the table of contents) |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|
| **s** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **s*** |
| **r** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **r*** |
| **b** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **b*** |
| **g** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **g*** |
| **d** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **d*** |
| **m** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **m*** |
| **a** | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed **a*** |

These seven prefixes are the only ones that receive their own dedicated chapters in Benedict’s 1972 work. (Source: Google Books “output=txt” view of the book, which lists the chapter titles with page numbers — See: *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed s p 105, prefixed r p 109, prefixed b p 110, prefixed g p 112, prefixed d p 114, prefixed m p 117, prefixed a p 121*.)
